regulatory.heading: Get ready for PPWR without chasing suppliers by email.
regulatory.body: New EU packaging obligations require companies to hold increasingly structured information about their products and packaging. Sourcelya helps you collect and organise that information at the source: your suppliers.
regulatory.disclaimer: Sourcelya helps you collect and organise documentation and does not replace specialised legal advice.
